title: The same tab-held part with the R-TABS fact (t_hold = 2.5 mm): the tab holds
rationale: With the relaxation R-TABS open at t_hold = 2.5 mm (rung R7), a groove leaving 3 mm holds (15 mm deep is not deeper than T - t_hold = 15.5 mm), so the part stays attached and M-ATTACH must not be raised. Only the lifting is asserted: the design's 'passes only with an R-TABS fact'.
